mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (user_id, bank, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bank}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bank = VALUES(bank), created_at = VALUES(created_at)
INSERT INTO portfolios (user_id, fintech_use_num) VALUES (#{userId}, #{fintechUseNum}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fintech_use_num = VALUES(fintech_use_num)
